steps.en: The officer opens a list of requests waiting for review
steps.id: Officer membuka daftar permintaan yang menunggu review

steps.en: The list shows notice, vehicle, submission time and current stage
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan notice, kendaraan, waktu submission, dan stage saat ini
steps.why_en: The stage shown is the one recorded at submission, not necessarily the notice's stage now.
steps.why_id: Stage yang tampil adalah yang tercatat saat submission, belum tentu stage notice saat ini.

steps.en: Requests are ordered by submission time and by ID number
steps.id: Permintaan diurutkan berdasarkan waktu submission dan nomor ID
steps.why_en: No default order; sorting by submission time needs a click, and there is no ID column to sort by.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada urutan default; sort waktu submission perlu klik, dan tidak ada kolom ID untuk diurutkan.

steps.en: Clicking a request opens its full details and proof documents
steps.id: Klik pada permintaan membuka detail lengkap dan dokumen bukti
